timeline.summary: Selenia now serves Volrath in Rath.
timeline.quote: Selenia now serves the evil Volrath in his home realm of Rath.

citation.text: Selenia (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and sold it off piece by piece.
timeline.quote: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece.

citation.text: Volrath (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath becomes an evincar of the Lord of the Wastes.
timeline.quote: Now, he is an evincar, or agent, of the Lord of the Wastes.

citation.text: Volrath (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec rises through schemes and assassinations blessed by Volrath.
timeline.quote: Greven has attained his powerful rank through a series of underhanded schemes and assassinations

citation.text: Greven il-Vec (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri wages guerrilla war against Volrath.
timeline.quote: The guerilla war he wages against Volrath

citation.text: Eladamri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The sliver queen is held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold.
timeline.quote: Though long held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold, the sliver queen is actually freer than most of Rath's denizens.

citation.text: Sliver Queen, Brood Mother (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.quote: Starke poisoned the paint with which ritual tattoos were placed on his body

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath Greven captures Karn and he is tortured in Volrath's Stronghold until Gerrard rescues him.
timeline.quote: Karn was captured by Greven as he refused to fight off his attackers

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Stronghold, Mirri's sense of smell exposes a shapeshifting minion of Volrath disguised as Sisay.
timeline.quote: Her sense of smell saved the crew from one of Volrath 's shapeshifting minions

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard must face his blood brother Vuel, who as Volrath became Yawgmoth's first in command.
timeline.quote: becoming Yawgmoth's first in command

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath tells Karn he has failed Gerrard and the Legacy.
timeline.quote: You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy.

citation.text: Propaganda (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath vows to bind Crovax with pain.
timeline.quote: I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream.

citation.text: Endless Scream (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath berates Greven for failing to capture Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard

citation.text: Fevered Convulsions (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath warns Greven about free will.
timeline.quote: Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven

citation.text: Puppet Strings (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A counterfeit accepted by the sliver hive increases Volrath's influence.
timeline.quote: Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

citation.text: Metallic Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.quote: Gerrard suddenly had flashbacks to his youth and the actions of Vuel, and realized the truth: Volrath was Vuel!

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard stabs his brother, but later learns he killed only a shapeshifter scapegoat.
timeline.quote: Volrath had used a scapegoat and that he had just killed another shapeshifter

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath orders Greven to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.

timeline.summary: Volrath has vanished and the Stronghold falls into chaos; Greven takes charge and meets candidate Crovax and emissary Belbe.
timeline.quote: the evincar had disappeared, throwing the rest of the Stronghold into chaos.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Ertai interfered by magically off-balancing Volrath, allowing Crovax to triumph.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath draws the Kor into Rath along with other peoples.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath takes a number of the Sliver Queen's brood away to study them in the Furnace of Rath.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath uses the hive to guard the Legacy and attack the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Volrath used the hive to guard the Legacy and to attack Weatherlight and her crew on their quest to retake those artifacts and their captain, Sisay .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out on stormy Rath to find Volrath's stronghold.
timeline.quote: where Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out to find Volrath 's stronghold

citation.text: "Tempest", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Vec are trapped on Rath by Volrath's will and divide into en-Vec and il-Vec.
timeline.quote: who were trapped on the plane of Rath by the will of Volrath

citation.text: "Vec", section "Vec". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Now you get to die.

citation.text: Smite (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.quote: you taught me so much yet learned so little.

citation.text: Contempt (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri is startled by Volrath's scentless apparition.

citation.text: Intruder Alarm (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.quote: Volrath has killed me.

citation.text: Torment (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke cries out to Takara but she obeys Volrath.

timeline.quote: Volrath shaped us to it.

citation.text: Skyshroud Troopers (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Horn of Greed (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Theft of Dreams (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: giving Vuel the Touchstone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vuel murders Sidar Kondo.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: Reflecting Pool (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
